rounds.text: Neochem Bio Solutions Ltd is highly under-appreciated, trading at a conservative P/E of 12.5 [E1] and a P/B of 1.98x [E2], which leaves a massive 68.1% margin of safety compared to its intrinsic value of Rs 285 per share [E36, E37]. This low valuation is disconnected from the company's exceptional growth, highlighted by a 32% compounded sales growth over three years [E14] and a 122% compounded profit growth over the same period [E16]. Furthermore, the business delivers outstanding capital efficiency with a 28.0% ROCE [E12] and a 25.3% ROE [E13], while simultaneously de-leveraging by reducing borrowings from Rs 36 Cr to Rs 18 Cr in Mar 2026 [E30]. With 47% capacity headroom still available in its existing facility, the company possesses significant embedded growth potential without requiring major manufacturing capex in the near term [E62, E64]. Conceded: the company faces near-term working capital pressure, with working capital days increasing to 164 days [E45], high debtors of 161 days [E44], and negative operating cash flow of Rs -19 Cr in Mar 2026 [E25]. However, management aims to bring trade receivables down to around 120 days by the end of FY27 [E58], and the broader chemical sector tailwind supports continued operational expansion [E51, E52].
